Nothing is invented. A fabricated GUID produces a package that compiles without complaint
and then draws nothing at all, with no error to tell you why - which is the worst possible
failure mode. Fill these in against a library you actually have, then set "resolved": true.
Fixtures that are still unresolved are skipped, not faked. A build with unresolved fixtures
is a valid partial build. See docs/bindings.md.

obstruction_red_beacon.description: Flashing red obstruction beacon for the top of a structure. FAA L-864: red, 20-40 flashes per minute. This is the single most important binding in the package - it is what makes a mast readable at night.

obstruction_red_steady.description: Steady red side light, ringed at intermediate levels below the top beacon. FAA L-810: steady-burning, not flashing. Placed four to a level every 150 ft.

obstruction_white_strobe.description: Medium-intensity white strobe, FAA L-865. Used at every level of a white-marked structure rather than only at the top, three to a level every 250 ft. Bound here to the strobe from the coms2014-lights library.
